_comment: Guest instruction patches, lifted as run-time switches (ppu_lifter.py --insn-patches):
each becomes `if (guard) {new} else {orig}`; the guards are defined in port/game_patches.cpp.
The lift stops if `orig` is not the instruction at `addr`, so these only ever apply to

entry_hooks: each {addr, host, guard} makes the lifted function at addr begin with `if (guard) { host(ctx); return; }` -- the port's host function in its place, for a replacement that needs state or host code (ppu_lifter.py --insn-patches).

patches.note: func_008D0EBC (FMOD MultiStream MP3 codec load): its failure exit `li r11,33` becomes `li r11,0`, so a missing /dev_flash/sys/external/flashMP3.pic reports success with no codec loaded (the stat fails before anything is allocated)

main loop (0x2A5C8): after a frame it sleeps 30000 us minus the frame's time (`cmpdi r3,29999` skips the sleep when the frame took longer). Comparing with -1 always skips it: no 30 ms minimum frame time
func_00029BD8 (frame pacing): waits until cellGcmGetVBlankCount() has advanced by more than 1 since the last frame (2 vblanks: 30 fps). `> 0` waits for 1 vblank: 60 fps
the same test in that wait's loop
func_00029BD8: the vblank difference (`sub r0,r3,r0`) replaced with 2, so the wait never blocks: no vblank cap
the same in that wait's loop

entry_hooks.note: func_000A2C14 rounds a float to 0.01 by truncation, (int)(v * 100 + 0.005) * 0.01. Called by func_00106CB8 on the hero's per-frame x and z step (+0x768, +0x770), it drops up to 0.01 a frame, so the hero slows as the frame rate rises; the host carries the dropped part into the next frame's step there and rounds exactly as before everywhere else (port/game_patches.cpp)
